evidence.description: Housing Ombudsman determination records the resident's complaint history, repair reports, and landlord response.

case.facts: The resident lives in a ground-floor flat. In August 2023, they contacted the landlord to ask when it would complete repairs to the render at the rear of the property and to a brick pillar in the front garden. While both the resident and his partner contacted the landlord during the complaints procedure, this report refers to them collectively as ‘the resident’. The complaint is about the landlord’s handling of: External repairs to the render of the property and a brick pillar in the garden. The associated complaint.
